# Fluent UI dependencies

The Windows 11 UI branch uses the official PySide6 distribution of QFluentWidgets.

| Package | Version | Published license | Upstream |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PySide6-Fluent-Widgets | 1.11.3 | GPLv3; upstream also offers commercial licensing | https://github.com/zhiyiYo/PyQt-Fluent-Widgets/tree/PySide6 |
| PySideSix-Frameless-Window | 0.8.2 | LGPLv3 | https://github.com/zhiyiYo/PyQt-Frameless-Window |

The accompanying license texts are copied from the installed distributions.
The upstream QFluentWidgets README describes its commercial license option:
https://github.com/zhiyiYo/PyQt-Fluent-Widgets#license

These notices describe the added dependencies; they do not assign a new license to DFAM's own source.
